lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Name's Marek Voss. Ship's engineer, or I was until my last captain sold the ship out from under me. Your port thruster is coughing and your coolant loop is worse.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: You're telling me you want the engineer's job?

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Someone has to keep this thing flying. Ten crates of supplies up front and the engine room is mine.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then you've got yourself an engineer. Show me the engine room before something in there develops opinions.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Your call. When that coolant loop goes, remember an engineer offered.

options.line: I cannot make that deal today.
